en.topic_title: Disciplinary board postpones hearing against fire safety firms over Tai Po blaze
en.topic_summary:
A disciplinary board has postponed a hearing for two fire safety contractors said to have failed to properly manage disabled fire safety systems before Wang Fuk Court went up in flames last year.



Chung Kit-man (centre), a director and engineer at Victory Fire Engineering, testifies at a public hearing on March 30, 2026, into the massive Tai Po fire. File photo: Hans Tse/HKFP.
